name: @carton/e2e
description: End-to-end tests of the whole Carton system: real processes, real files, real sockets. A Cardboard project on disk, the app's engine thread and materializer, cb processes and subagents, cuts and folds, .cbproj round trips, live sync between two machines through server-node and server-cloudflare (wrangler dev), media through blob-fs and blob-s3, and crash safety.
